# Package `crypto/rand`

```go
package rand
```

Package rand implements a cryptographically secure random number generator.

## Index

- [func Read](#func-read)
- [var Reader](#var-reader)

## Variables

### var Reader

```go
var Reader io.Reader = runtimeReader{}
```

Reader is a global, shared instance of a cryptographically secure random number generator. It is safe for concurrent use. The runtime supplies its entropy source through InstanceOptions.Entropy.

## Functions

### func Read

```go
func Read(data []byte) (int, error)
```

Read fills b with bytes from the runtime's cryptographically secure random source. It returns the error reported by Reader.
